semantics.Available: Production accepted, user executable, and not materially scope-limited for the advertised capability.
semantics.Limited: Production accepted and user executable only within an explicit governed scope.
semantics.Preview: A visible surface may exist, but Production acceptance or executable authority is not complete.
semantics.Blocked: The capability is implemented or registered but a governing block forbids user execution.
semantics.Coming later: The capability is registered/planned but not implemented for Production use.
